lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters organized into at least four primary horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated luminance that intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at regular intervals, creating a series of high-contrast grid-like anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal features on the upper-third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity transition from high luminance on the superior edge to shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately six discrete high-luminance blobs are visible on the mid-to-lower section of the first dorsal fin's silhouette before frame truncation at the upper-right boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin leading edge displays a high-density gradient of smaller, less regular high-intensity clusters transitioning to larger, more spaced spots on the posterior surface.
